158586.overview:
Terebi Oekaki (テレビおえかき) is the game packaged with the Sega Graphic Board for the SG-1000. It is a simple paint program.

This was the first game to feature the use of touch controls. It required the use of the Sega Graphic Board tablet, along with a stylus pen that came with it.

173851.overview: Tank Battalion is a 1980 arcade game by Namco which was brought to the MSX in 1984. It was subsequently ported to the SG-1000 in Taiwan and Sega Master System in South Korea.

173852.overview: TwinBee is a 1985 arcade game by Konami which was brought to the MSX in 1986. The MSX version was subsequently ported to the SG-1000 in Taiwan.
